1. (Currently Amended) A proofed frozen dough comprising: (a) a dough mixture of flour, water, and optionally additives, the dough mixture defining a dough matrix; (b) gas bubbles dispersed throughout the dough matrix; (c) a spent yeast component; and (d) a preserved yeast component, wherein the preserved yeast component comprises encapsulated yeast, fat-coated yeast, non-hydrated active dry yeast, non-hydrated instant yeast, non-hydrated semi-dry yeast, non-hydrated frozen yeast, or a combination thereof.

2. (Currently Amended) The proofed frozen dough of claim 1, wherein the proofed frozen dough comprises about 1 to about 8 wt.% of the spent yeast component.

7. (Currently Amended) The proofed frozen dough of claim 1, wherein the proofed frozen dough comprises about 0.1 to about 2 wt.% of the preserved yeast component.

8. (Currently Amended) The proofed frozen dough of claim 1, wherein the preserved yeast component comprises encapsulated yeast, fat-coated yeast, non-hydrated active dry yeast, non-hydrated instant yeast, non-hydrated semi-dry yeast, non-hydrated frozen yeast, or a combination thereof, and the preserved yeast component has a yeast vitality of at least 50 % of its initial vitality.

11. (Currently Amended) The proofed frozen dough of claim 1, wherein the gas bubbles comprise gas produced by the spent yeast component during proofing, wherein at least 60 % of the first yeast is spent during proofing.

13. (Currently Amended) A method for making a frozen dough product, the method comprising: (a) mixing dough ingredients to produce a dough composition, the dough ingredients comprising: i. water; ii. flour; iii. a first yeast; and iv. a second yeast, wherein the second yeast comprises encapsulated yeast; (b) proofing the dough, wherein during proofing the first yeast is spent and the second yeast is preserved; and (c) freezing the dough after proofing.

14. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 13, wherein at least 60 % of the first yeast is spent during proofing.

15. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 13, wherein at least 50 % of the second yeast is preserved during proofing.

22. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 13 further comprising: shaping and cutting the dough to produce a pizza crust prior to proofing; freezing the pizza crust; and applying toppings to the frozen pizza crust.
